spec._comment: Round 3 (C uses the whole original train+valid so C does not regress; its test/ split stays untouched). A = 3 reviewed basin photos (real_001/004 train, real_007 pinned to test so at least one real basin photo is measured) + 13 dense PL Detection photos (head-box labels, MIT licence, Teramina). B has only real_003 so far; to_label/A and to_label/B hold unlabeled photos waiting for labels. The 4 medium-density bowl photos (real_005, real_008, real_011, real_012) fit none of A/B/C and are left out. Labels must follow ONE convention (head box); real_003 still has whole-body boxes. See docs/TECHSPEC.md section 15. Optional per-source key: "split": "train"|"valid"|"test" pins that source's photos.
